text:
marta: Heads-up: torrential sprinkle downtown + a stalled BART at 16th. Took me 40m from 22nd. Anyone else hit by the fun?

ev an: Yikes. I ducked for a scooter at 6th and it turned into a wet luge. Lost one shoe, not proud. :sweat_smile:

tess: lol @evan. I jumped off BART at 24th and took Muni — they were running trains but packed. If you can delay a bit, later runs seem emptier.

josh: FYI e-scooter company sent an outage SMS 1: "limited availability in rainy conditions". Guess we're all capsizing today.

brynn: Office update: the small umbrella crate next to the receptionist is stocked (blue + black). Please leave a note if you borrow. Also there6s a towel in the pantry for shoe rescue.

marta: thank you brynn 11 saved me. I left a tiny Post-it that says "redwood crew".

ev an: Anyone commuting from South Bay considering switching to SamTrans+bus? I might try that tomorrow if BART keeps being dramatic.

tess: Quick poll: what did you use today? react with emoji: :tram: BART, :bus: Muni/Bus, :motor_scooter: Scooter, :house_with_garden: Remote

josh: :tram:

ev an: :motor_scooter:

brynn: :bus:

commute-bot: Morning snapshot: BART 16th St delay cleared at 08:43. Expect light delays 09:00-09:30.

marta: Good to know. Also, if anyone's walking to/from Mission, watch for the loose manhole cover near 18th — city crews left a cone but it's slippery.

ev an: thanks! Reporting it to 311 now.

tess: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/umbrella-rain-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZYWc (mood)

marta: ok team 1 keep warm and dry. Ping here if you need a ride/umbrella swap later.
